title: Run Cadence Consistency Warning
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift ride exports (`zwift:activity`).
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as file inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=strava:activity sport=Run
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(cadence_spm) as avg_cadence, stdev(cadence_spm) as cadence_sd by athlete _time
| where cadence_sd>6
| sort - cadence_sd
description: Measures weekly spread in running cadence and flags inconsistent form weeks where your stride mechanics are jumping around more than usual.
value: Cadence is a cheap proxy for form consistency; watching its variability can reveal fatigue, injury compensation, or sloppy easy runs before they become a habit.
implementation: Ingest cadence from running activities; schedule weekly and review weeks where cadence standard deviation stays elevated.
visualization: Weekly chart of average cadence with standard-deviation markers.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when your running rhythm gets unusually inconsistent, which can be a sign of fatigue or sloppy form.
